confirmed_blocking.summary: Drop can select an inherited run copy instead of the current worktree's own run (ENG-26, ENG-1).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: The filter compares identity['worktree'] (where the state copy was found) with cwd, then takes matches[0]. An inherited pr-open state that is not deduped sorts before the current run and is dropped. No test covers multiple state copies in one worktree.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Match only runs whose state's own `worktree` field resolves to cwd (is_authoritative) and whose branch equals the checked-out branch; refuse on zero or multiple matches. Add a regression test with an inherited orphaned pr-open state.

confirmed_blocking.summary: Failed-drop rollback discards pre-existing staged/unstaged changes in the run folder and deletes the only archive (ENG-26, SC-003).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: git rm -r refuses locally modified files; the except branch runs `git reset HEAD -- folder` and `git checkout HEAD -- folder`, then rmtree(target). The commit-failure test covers only a clean tree.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Before any copy or git mutation, refuse when `git status --porcelain -- <folder> <design target> <map>` reports staged or unstaged changes (naming them); add tests for staged and unstaged changes.

confirmed_blocking.summary: Archive copy and verification exclude every nested file named lock.json, not only the run's root lock (FR-003, FR-005, SC-002).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: shutil.ignore_patterns('lock.json') applies in every directory; filecmp.dircmp(ignore=['lock.json']) propagates to subdirs.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Use an ignore callable that excludes lock.json only when the directory is path.parent, and verify nested lock.json files; add a nested-lock preservation test.

confirmed_blocking.summary: Untracked files in factory/design/ are staged into the drop commit, which step 9 auto-pushes (ENG-25, FR-006).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: `git mv` renames the directory including untracked files, then `git add -- <design>` stages every non-ignored untracked file there.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Remove the `git add -- <design>` call (git mv already stages the tracked moves) or stage only `git ls-files` output; leave untracked/ignored leftovers in the archive only. Add a test asserting an untracked design file is absent from the commit.

confirmed_blocking.summary: Drop commits unrelated uncommitted edits in docs/design-code-map.json (FR-006, FR-017).
confirmed_blocking.evidence: The map is read from the working tree, rewritten and committed, so unrelated staged or unstaged edits ride into the drop commit.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Refuse before mutation when the map has staged or unstaged changes (same pre-check as the run-folder dirty check), or rewrite from the HEAD blob; test both staged and unstaged edits.

advisory.summary: ENG-26: git-removal path comes from state.json spec_dir rather than the discovered state path.
advisory.fix: Derive folder from path.parent relative to the worktree and refuse when it differs from `<spec_dir>/factory`.

advisory.summary: ENG-24: copytree dereferences symlinks; archive stays local.
advisory.fix: Pass symlinks=True and compare link targets in verification, or refuse links resolving outside the run folder.

advisory.summary: ENG-23: run lock released before git rm/commit/rmtree.
advisory.fix: Hold the lock until the commit and rmtree complete.

advisory.summary: Spec gap: moved evidence metadata keeps stale specs/<branch>/factory/design/ paths.
advisory.fix: Amend FR-017 to also rewrite the prefix in moved design JSON metadata, or state that post-drop metadata paths are historical.

advisory.summary: Spec/doc gap: design-code-mapping.md section 3 still allows an existing map at another path.
advisory.fix: Align design-code-mapping.md section 3 with FR-017's single canonical path, or have drop read state.design.map.

rejected.reason: Contradicts the spec: removal commit holds only tracked files; force-adding ignored files would override .gitignore and could publish local content (conflicts with confirmed SEC-2). Ignored design files are preserved in the archive.
